args: root=$1; case $root in ""|*"\${"*) root=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}} ;; esac; [ -f "$root/bin/past" ] || root=$PWD; if [ ! -f "$root/bin/past" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.past/devin/past.mjs" ]; then root=$(sed -n "s|.*file://\(.*\)/bin/past-hook\.mjs.*|\1|p" "$HOME/.past/devin/past.mjs"); fi; [ -f "$root/bin/past" ] || { echo "past.dev: the plugin folder was not found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec sh "$root/bin/past" mcp
